title: AI review findings (Claude)
description: Structured output contract for the one-shot Claude review pass. Kept in sync by hand with the `assertFindings` validator in .github/scripts/ai-review/post-review.ts.

summary.description: An honest executive summary of the review. An empty `findings` array with a summary explaining the diff is clean is a valid, correct result.

id.description: Stable short identifier for this finding, e.g. `claude-1`.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the file the finding applies to.

line.description: 1-based line number on the new (RIGHT) side of the diff.

end_line.description: Optional 1-based end line, for findings spanning a range.

severity.description: critical = security issue or breaks users; major = likely bug or data loss; minor = correctness/quality concern; nit = style/polish.

claim.description: The finding itself, stated as a concrete claim.

evidence.description: Concrete file:line evidence backing the claim, verified against the surrounding code, not just the diff.

suggested_fix.description: Optional concrete suggestion for how to address the finding.
